    Travel essentials

    Travel packing list

    The gear we actually pack for long trips — light, useful and worth the space in your bag.

    As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

    Power & tech

    • 🔌

      Universal / Japan Type-A plug adapter

      Japan uses two-flat-pin Type A/B sockets, so most European, UK and Turkish plugs won’t fit without one.

      View on Amazon.com ↗Also on Amazon.com.tr
    • 🔋

      Portable charger (10,000 mAh, flight-safe)

      Keeps maps, tickets and your camera going all day; 10,000 mAh is well within airline carry-on limits.

      View on Amazon.com ↗Also on Amazon.com.tr
    • ☕

      Portable rechargeable espresso maker (USB-C)

      Proper coffee in the hotel room or on an early train, charged over USB-C.

      View on Amazon.com ↗Also on Amazon.com.tr

    Out and about

    • 👜

      Anti-theft crossbody day bag

      RFID-blocking pockets and a slash-resistant strap keep passport, cards and cash safe in crowded stations.

      View on Amazon.com ↗Also on Amazon.com.tr
    • ☂️

      Compact windproof travel umbrella

      Light enough to live in your day bag for sudden showers and the rainy season.

      View on Amazon.com ↗Also on Amazon.com.tr
    • 🩹

      Hydrocolloid blister bandages

      Japan days easily top 15,000 steps — these cushion hot spots and protect blisters so you keep walking.

      Packing cubes / luggage organiser set
